expansion_contract.fact_row: verified official-source, canonical-state, workflow-evidence or acceptance-contract fact
expansion_contract.boundary_row: prevents operator forecasts, confidence classifications, residential projections, local-authority aggregates or unpublished planning evidence from being promoted to exact current postcode or parcel coverage without accepted r2 bytes and hardened postjoin evidence

source_routes.name: About this data fixed coverage v2

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

facts.detail: The exact 11,013-row output JSONL remains empty.
The source snapshot remains exact_rows_returned zero and source_scan_complete remains false.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact r2 and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: The PND report uses network operators' stated deployment plans as of January 2026.
The report examines planned deployment over the following three years, ending in January 2029.

guard_streams.write_limit: A future plan is not current January 2026 coverage.

facts.detail: PND 2026 is explicitly forward-looking and supplements the Connected Nations Spring update.
The Spring update is the separate snapshot of existing coverage as of January 2026.

guard_streams.write_limit: Forecast and observed-coverage products must remain separate.

facts.detail: Operator plans may be privately funded or supported through public funds or intervention.
The report does not separately include rollout aspirations or plans of national or local public authorities.

guard_streams.write_limit: Public policy aspirations cannot be added to operator plan coverage.

facts.detail: High Confidence requires the plan to have reached at least Low Level Design Complete.
High Confidence also requires funding to have been committed.

guard_streams.write_limit: A plan lacking either criterion must not be treated as High Confidence.

facts.detail: The confidence criteria were chosen to align with BDUK National Rolling Open Market Review classifications.
The classification describes plan maturity and funding, not a probability of service for an individual parcel.

guard_streams.write_limit: Plan confidence cannot raise parcel coverage accuracy.

facts.detail: Ofcom states that operator deployment plans can change even when advanced and committed.
The PND figures cannot be considered comprehensive or definitive.
The PND key findings refer to residential properties only.
Projected percentages use the same 30.5 million residential-premise base as the Spring 2026 update.

guard_streams.write_limit: Residential projections cannot be joined to all-premises postcode rows.

facts.detail: Residential-and-business planned results are supplied in a local-authority deployment file.
The published headline and local-authority products do not establish an exact current postcode or parcel observation.

guard_streams.write_limit: Local-authority planning aggregates cannot replace the all-premises r2 postcode archive.

facts.detail: If all plans are realised, full fibre could reach 28.1 million homes, or 92 percent, by January 2029.
Gigabit-capable coverage could reach 29 million homes, or 95 percent, by January 2029.

guard_streams.write_limit: National projections are not current postcode metrics.

facts.detail: The current all-plans projection for full-fibre coverage is 90 percent by January 2028.
High Confidence plans imply 87 percent by January 2028 and 88 percent by January 2029.

guard_streams.write_limit: All-plans and High Confidence scenarios must remain separate.

facts.detail: Urban residential gigabit coverage could move from 24.2 million or 93 percent to 25.3 million or 97 percent by January 2029.
Rural residential gigabit coverage could move from 2.9 million or 66 percent to 3.7 million or 86 percent by January 2029.

guard_streams.write_limit: Rural and urban projections cannot be assigned to a target postcode without exact current data.

facts.detail: Plans exist for all local authorities and 95 percent are estimated to reach at least 85 percent residential gigabit coverage by January 2029 if all plans are realised.
Ofcom notes that some planned build adds coverage while some overbuilds existing or other planned networks.

guard_streams.write_limit: Build volume cannot be summed as unique newly covered premises.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom PND 2026, PND background and GitHub evidence

facts.detail: By end-2028, 73 percent of UK homes are projected to have at least two gigabit-capable networks and 36 percent at least three.
Operator-specific property coverage supplied to government is not public; available GitHub checks found no PR-triggered run or exact-postjoin PASS artifact for the checked HEAD.

guard_streams.write_limit: Network-choice projections and unpublished government detail cannot promote an exact parcel candidate.
